name: papertalk
description: Paper, blog post or X post in → a 1–2.5 minute explainer video where the picture shows exactly what the voice says.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: free: made on this computer, no key, about 90 MB downloads once. elevenlabs: more natural, needs your ElevenLabs API key below. own-files: you bring WAV files from another text-to-speech service.

local_voice.title: Free voice
local_voice.description: Which free voice to use: am_michael (male) or af_heart (female); bm_george and bf_emma are British.

elevenlabs_api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key
elevenlabs_api_key.description: Only if you chose elevenlabs. Kept in your system keychain, never in a file or in the chat.

output_dir.title: Folder for your videos
output_dir.description: Where sources, scripts, voices and finished videos go. Leave empty for ~/papertalk.
